updates.note: Management re-stated the long-term operating range of working capital cycle to be 45 to 50 days.
updates.quote: we expect the working capital cycle to settle within our long-term operating range of 45 to 50 days.

updates.note: Export contribution target of north of 10% by 2030 was re-affirmed.
updates.quote: We have given our guidance of going north of 10% of our overall top line by 2030.

updates.note: Reiterated Project Spring FMEG EBITDA margin target of 8% to 10% by FY 2030.
updates.quote: where we target EBITDA margins of 8% to 10% by FY 2030.

updates.note: Re-affirmed INR 4,500 crores execution piece for Bharat Net over 3 years.
updates.quote: So there is a INR 4,500 crores execution piece of the contract of INR 8,000 crores overall.

new_promises.statement: Maintain Wires and Cables medium to long-term margin guidance of 11% to 13%.
new_promises.quote: we continue to maintain our medium- to long-term margin guidance of 11% to 13% for this business.
new_promises.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

new_promises.statement: Expect FMEG business to grow at 1.5x to 2x of industry growth.
new_promises.quote: Our strategic priorities remain unchanged to grow at 1.5x to 2x of the industry growth while progressively enhancing profitability.
new_promises.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

new_promises.statement: Expect sustainable operating margins for the EPC business to remain in high single digits.
new_promises.quote: Over the medium to long term, we continue to expect sustainable operating margins for the EPC business to remain in the high single-digit range.
new_promises.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
